title: docs: add Vast GPU fleet management skill
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a repository-owned skill for fleet audits, offer qualification, isolated canaries, and human-approved promotion
- Defines the €10/month cash-savings threshold, 99.7% reliability floor, E2E checks, and one-candidate limit
- Requires verified production attribution before immediately destroying the replaced GPU
- Defines the post-cutover inventory/runbook PR and links Flux and Z-Image docs to the skill
- Records machines 137831 and 137833 as temporarily excluded after Docker pull failures

Checks: skill validator; `git diff --check`; targeted link and secret-pattern validation

gist.headline: The GPU Garden Gets Rules
gist.blurb: The fleet now has a field guide for trying new GPU soil without uprooting the whole garden. Canaries stay small, promotions need a human nod, and flaky machines get politely marked off the map.
gist.summary: Added a repository-owned Vast GPU fleet-management skill covering offer qualification, isolated one-candidate canaries, a €10/month savings threshold, a 99.7% reliability floor, E2E checks, verified production attribution before GPU replacement cleanup, and post-cutover inventory/runbook updates.
gist.impact: Operators now have a shared, auditable process for safely evaluating and promoting Vast GPU instances, while machines 137831 and 137833 remain temporarily excluded after Docker pull failures.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful fleet gardener inspecting a small, isolated GPU-server seedling before it joins a healthy server garden. A clipboard shows a 99.7% reliability check and a tiny human approval stamp, while two gently fenced-off servers are labeled 137831 and 137833; include code-plants and a calm CRT monitor companion to represent documented operational checks.
